const candidate = String(value ?? '');
if (!candidate || /[\u0000-\u0020\u007f"'()\\<>{};*`]|[?#]/u.test(candidate)) return '';
    if (/%(?:0[0-9a-f]|1[0-9a-f]|7f|22|27|28|29|3b|3c|3e|5c|60|7b|7d)/iu.test(candidate)) return '';
    if (/^https?:\/\//iu.test(candidate)) {
      try {
        if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(new URL(candidate).protocol)) return '';
      } catch (_error) {
        return '';
      }
    } else if (!(candidate.startsWith('./')
      || candidate.startsWith('../')
      || (candidate.startsWith('/') && !candidate.startsWith('//')))) return '';
    return candidate.endsWith('/') ? candidate : `${candidate}/`;
  }

  // 注册表里的头像路径相对于 avatarBase（即 profile photo/），允许带子目录，例如 profile photo/gr/凯莎.png。
  function avatarPath(character) {
    const raw = String(character.avatar || `${character.canonicalName || ''}.png`).replace(/\\/gu, '/');
    const segments = raw
      .replace(/^(?:\.\/)?profile photo\//u, '')
      .split('/')
      .filter((segment) => segment && segment !== '.' && segment !== '..');
    if (!segments.length || segments.at(-1) === '.png') return '';
    return segments.map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
  }

  function avatarUrl(character) {
    const relativePath = avatarPath(character);
    return relativePath && runtimeAvatarBase ? `${runtimeAvatarBase}${relativePath}` : '';
  }

  function setText(element, value) {
    if (element) element.textContent = String(value ?? '');
    return element;
  }

  function makeElement(tagName, className, textValue) {
    const element = document.createElement(tagName);
    if (className) element.className = className;
    if (textValue !== undefined) element.textContent = String(textValue);
    return element;
  }

  function cleanTimelineLabel(value) {
    return String(value || '')
      .replace(/【\s*推算\s*】/gu, '')
      .replace(/\s+/gu, ' ')
      .trim();
  }

  function renderMetadata() {
    const title = core.normalizeStory(sources.story) || '未归档章节';
    const displayTitle = `剧情-${title}`;
    const time = cleanTimelineLabel(core.normalizeTime(sources.time));
    const timeMatch = time.match(/^(\d{4})年(0[1-9]|1[0-2])月(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])日$/u);
    if (timeMatch) {
      setText(elements.time, `时间 ${time}`);
      elements.time?.setAttribute('datetime', `${timeMatch[1]}-${timeMatch[2]}-${timeMatch[3]}`);
    } else {
      setText(elements.time, '时间 未知');
      elements.time?.removeAttribute('datetime');
    }

    const chapterRecords = boot.titleRegistry?.c;
    const chapterRecord = chapterRecords && Object.hasOwn(chapterRecords, title)
      ? chapterRecords[title]
      : null;
    const trustedChapter = titleCode.decodeRecord(title, chapterRecord);
    root.classList.toggle('lz-title-known', Boolean(trustedChapter));
    if (!titleCode.render(elements.titleCode, trustedChapter, title)) {
      setText(elements.titleLayers[0], '剧情-未归档');
      setText(elements.titleLayers[1], title);
      elements.story?.setAttribute('aria-label', displayTitle);
    }

    const volumeName = boot.titleRegistry?.v?.[trustedChapter?.volumeOrder] || '';
    setText(elements.archiveIndex, volumeName || '未归档');
    setText(elements.volumeLabel, trustedChapter ? trustedChapter.id.replace('-', ' · ') : '');
    setText(elements.archiveVolume, trustedChapter ? `第 ${String(Number(trustedChapter.order) + 1).padStart(3, '0')} 篇` : '');
  }

  function hexToRgb(hex) {
    const normalized = String(hex || '').replace('#', '');
    if (!/^[0-9A-F]{6}$/iu.test(normalized)) return [117, 107, 97];
    return [0, 2, 4].map((offset) => Number.parseInt(normalized.slice(offset, offset + 2), 16));
  }

  function mixWithWhite(hex, amount) {
    const values = hexToRgb(hex).map((value) =>
      Math.round(value + (255 - value) * amount),
    );
    return `#${values.map((value) => value.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('')}`;
  }

  function applyCharacterPalette(element, character) {
    const colors = character.gradient?.length ? character.gradient : [character.accent, '#8B8177'];
    const nightColors = character.gradientNight?.length
      ? character.gradientNight
      : colors.map((color) =>
          character.textMode === 'ink' ? color : mixWithWhite(color, 0.55),
        );
    const c1 = colors[0] || character.accent;
    const c2 = colors[1] || c1;
    const c3 = colors[2] || c2;
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-char-accent', character.accent || '#756B61');
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-char-c1-day', c1);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-char-c2-day', c2);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-char-c3-day', c3);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-char-c1-night', nightColors[0] || c1);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-char-c2-night', nightColors[1] || nightColors[0] || c2);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-char-c3-night', nightColors[2] || nightColors[1] || c3);
    element.dataset.lzColored = 'true';
  }

  function boundedMaterialNumber(value, fallback, minimum, maximum) {
    const number = Number(value);
    return Number.isInteger(number) && number >= minimum && number <= maximum
      ? number
      : fallback;
  }

  function applyBubbleMaterial(element, character) {
    const source = character?.bubbleStyle;
    const family = BUBBLE_FAMILIES.has(source?.family)
      ? source.family
      : BUBBLE_DEFAULT.family;
    const angle = boundedMaterialNumber(source?.angle, BUBBLE_DEFAULT.angle, 0, 179);
    const step = boundedMaterialNumber(source?.step, BUBBLE_DEFAULT.step, 12, 32);
    const radius = boundedMaterialNumber(source?.radius, BUBBLE_DEFAULT.radius, 4, 24);
    const grain = boundedMaterialNumber(source?.grain, BUBBLE_DEFAULT.grain, 2, 12);
    const edge = boundedMaterialNumber(source?.edge, BUBBLE_DEFAULT.edge, 1, 3);
    element.dataset.lzMaterial = family;
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-bubble-angle', `${angle}deg`);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-bubble-step', `${step}px`);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-bubble-radius', `${radius}px`);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-bubble-grain', `${grain}%`);
    element.style.setProperty('--lz-bubble-edge', `${edge}px`);
  }

  function appendName(target, name, character, decorated) {
    const label = makeElement('span', 'lz-dialogue__name-label');
    if (!decorated) {
      setText(label, name);
      target.append(label);
      return;
    }
    for (const part of core.segmentName(name)) {
      const segment = makeElement('span', part.accented ? 'is-accented' : '', part.character);
      label.append(segment);
    }
    target.append(label, makeElement('span', 'lz-dialogue__symbol', character.icon || '◇'));
  }

  function createAvatar(character, options = {}) {
    const avatar = makeElement('div', 'lz-dialogue__avatar');
    const fallback = makeElement('span', 'lz-dialogue__fallback', character.fallbackGlyph || '？');
    avatar.append(fallback);
    if (character.hasAvatar) {
      const sigil = makeElement('span', 'lz-dialogue__avatar-sigil', character.icon || '◇');
      sigil.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      avatar.append(sigil);
    }

    const override = avatarOverrideSource(character.displayName) || avatarOverrideSource(character.canonicalName);
    const source = override
      || (options.player ? (options.playerAvatar || '') : '')
      || (character.hasAvatar ? avatarUrl(character) : '');
    if (override) avatar.classList.add('has-override');
    if (source) {
      const image = document.createElement('img');
      image.alt = '';
      image.loading = 'lazy';
      image.decoding = 'async';
      image.addEventListener('load', () => avatar.classList.add('has-image'), { once: true });
      image.addEventListener('error', () => image.remove(), { once: true });
      image.src = source;
      avatar.prepend(image);
    }
    return avatar;
  }

  function appendParagraphs(container, paragraphs, className) {
    for (const paragraph of paragraphs || []) {
      container.append(makeElement('p', className, paragraph));
    }
  }

  function renderNarration(token) {
    const section = makeElement('section', 'lz-narration');
    appendParagraphs(section, token.paragraphs, 'lz-narration__paragraph');
    return section;
  }

  // 其他前端（状态栏、面板等）在不透明来源的沙盒 iframe 里独立渲染：脚本能跑，但触不到阅读器、酒馆页面与本地存储。
  // 高度由沙盒内的小脚本通过 postMessage 上报。
  let embedSerial = 0;
  const embedFrames = new Map();
  function renderEmbed(token) {
    const section = makeElement('section', 'lz-embed');
    const frame = document.createElement('iframe');
    const ticket = `lz-embed-${Date.now().toString(36)}-${(embedSerial += 1)}`;
    frame.className = 'lz-embed__frame';
    frame.setAttribute('sandbox', 'allow-scripts');
    frame.setAttribute('title', '嵌入内容');
    frame.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
    frame.setAttribute('scrolling', 'no');
    const colorScheme = state.theme === 'black' ? 'dark' : 'light';
    // 注意 <\/script>：这段字符串本身位于阅读器的内联 <script> 里，不能出现字面量的结束标签。
    const reporter = `<script>(function(){var t=${JSON.stringify(ticket)};function s(){try{parent.postMessage({lzEmbed:t,height:Math.max(document.documentElement.scrollHeight,document.body?document.body.scrollHeight:0)},'*')}catch(e){}}addEventListener('load',s);if(window.ResizeObserver){new ResizeObserver(s).observe(document.documentElement)}setTimeout(s,60);setInterval(s,1500)})()<\/script>`;
    frame.srcdoc = `<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><style>html{color-scheme:${colorScheme}}html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:transparent}body{overflow:hidden}img,video{max-width:100%}</style></head><body>${token.html}${reporter}</body></html>`;
    embedFrames.set(ticket, frame);
    section.append(frame);
    return section;
  }

  globalThis.addEventListener?.('message', (event) => {
    const data = event.data;
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || typeof data.lzEmbed !== 'string') return;
    const frame = embedFrames.get(data.lzEmbed);
    if (!frame || event.source !== frame.contentWindow) return;
    const height = Number(data.height);
    if (Number.isFinite(height) && height > 0) frame.style.height = `${Math.min(Math.ceil(height), 4000)}px`;
  });

  function isPlayerSpeaker(name) {
    return Boolean(playerName) && core.normalizeSpeaker(name) === playerName;
  }

  function renderDialogue(token) {
    const character = core.resolveCharacter(token.speaker, boot.characterRegistry || {});
    const player = isPlayerSpeaker(token.speaker);
    const article = makeElement('article', 'lz-dialogue');
    article.classList.toggle('lz-dialogue--player', player);
    article.classList.toggle('lz-dialogue--generic', !character.hasAvatar);
    article.classList.toggle('lz-dialogue--ink', character.textMode === 'ink');
    article.classList.toggle('is-player', player);
    article.classList.toggle('is-generic', !character.hasAvatar);
    article.classList.toggle('is-ink', character.textMode === 'ink');
    article.dataset.lzBubble = character.bubble || 'generic';
    applyCharacterPalette(article, character);
    applyBubbleMaterial(article, character);

    const avatar = createAvatar(character, {
      player: player,
      playerAvatar: player ? state.playerAvatar : null,
    });
    const body = makeElement('div', 'lz-dialogue__body');
    const nameTag = makeElement('button', 'lz-dialogue__name');
    nameTag.type = 'button';
    nameTag.dataset.lzSpeaker = character.displayName;
    if (player) nameTag.dataset.lzPlayerName = 'true';
    nameTag.title = '更换头像';
    nameTag.setAttribute('aria-label', `${token.speaker}：更换头像`);
    nameTag.addEventListener('click', (event) => openAvatarEditor(character, event.currentTarget));
    appendName(nameTag, character.displayName, character, character.hasAvatar);

    const bubble = makeElement('div', 'lz-dialogue__bubble');
    appendParagraphs(bubble, token.paragraphs, 'lz-dialogue__text');
    body.append(nameTag, bubble);
    article.append(avatar, body);
    return article;
  }

  function makeSceneMeta(label, value) {
    if (!value) return null;
    const item = makeElement('span', 'lz-scene__meta-item');
    item.append(makeElement('b', '', label), document.createTextNode(value));
    return item;
  }

  function renderScene(token, ordinal) {
    const section = makeElement('section', 'lz-scene lz-observed-effect');
    section.append(
      makeElement('span', 'lz-scene__index', String(ordinal).padStart(2, '0')),
      makeElement('span', 'lz-scene__rule'),
    );
    const copy = makeElement('div', 'lz-scene__copy');
    const heading = makeElement('div', 'lz-scene__heading');
    heading.append(makeElement('strong', 'lz-scene__location', token.location || '场景转换'));
    copy.append(heading);
    const meta = makeElement('div', 'lz-scene__meta');
    for (const item of [
      makeSceneMeta('时', token.time),
      makeSceneMeta('境', token.mood),
    ]) {
      if (item) meta.append(item);
    }
    if (meta.childElementCount) copy.append(meta);
    appendParagraphs(copy, token.paragraphs, 'lz-scene__caption');
    section.append(copy);
    return section;
  }

  function renderAbility(token) {
    const kind = token.type === 'authority' ? 'authority' : 'yanling';
    const kindLabel = kind === 'authority' ? '权柄' : '言灵';
    const section = makeElement(
      'section',
      `lz-ability lz-ability--${kind} lz-observed-effect`,
    );
    const visual = makeElement('div', 'lz-ability__visual');
    visual.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

    const copy = makeElement('div', 'lz-ability__copy');
    copy.append(makeElement('p', 'lz-ability__label', kindLabel));
    copy.append(makeElement('h2', 'lz-ability__name', token.name || '未命名'));
    if (token.user) copy.append(makeElement('p', 'lz-ability__user', `释放者｜${token.user}`));
    const effect = makeElement('div', 'lz-ability__effect');
    appendParagraphs(effect, token.paragraphs, 'lz-ability__effect-line');
    copy.append(effect);

    if (token.desc) {
      const description = makeElement('div', 'lz-ability__description');
      const descriptionText = makeElement('p', '', token.desc);
      description.append(descriptionText);
      if (Array.from(token.desc).length > 88) {
        description.classList.add('is-collapsed');
        const toggle = makeElement('button', 'lz-ability__toggle', '展开完整介绍');
        toggle.type = 'button';
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const expanded = toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
          toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!expanded));
          setText(toggle, expanded ? '展开完整介绍' : '收起介绍');
          description.classList.toggle('is-collapsed', expanded);
        });
        description.append(toggle);
      }
      copy.append(description);
    }

    section.append(visual, copy);
    return section;
  }

  function renderCheck(token) {
    const section = makeElement('section', 'lz-check lz-observed-effect');
    section.setAttribute(
      'aria-label',
      `${token.checkType || '检定'}：${token.actor || '未知行动者'}${token.target ? ` 对 ${token.target}` : ''}`,
    );

    const header = makeElement('div', 'lz-check__header');
    header.append(makeElement('span', 'lz-check__type', token.checkType || '检定'));
    const actors = makeElement('span', 'lz-check__actors');
    actors.append(makeElement('strong', '', token.actor || '未知行动者'));
    if (token.target) {
      actors.append(
        makeElement('span', 'lz-check__arrow', '→'),
        makeElement('strong', '', token.target),
      );
    }
    header.append(actors);

    const result = makeElement('div', 'lz-check__result');
    const lines = String(token.text || '')
      .split(/\n+/gu)
      .map((line) => line.trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
    for (const line of lines) result.append(makeElement('p', '', line));
    section.append(header, result);
    return section;
  }

  function renderContent() {
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    let sceneOrdinal = 0;
    const tokens = core.tokenizePlot(sources.plot, {
      registry: boot.characterRegistry || {},
    });
    for (const token of tokens) {
      if (token.type === 'dialogue') fragment.append(renderDialogue(token));
      else if (token.type === 'scene') {
        sceneOrdinal += 1;
        fragment.append(renderScene(token, sceneOrdinal));
      }
      else if (token.type === 'yanling' || token.type === 'authority') fragment.append(renderAbility(token));
      else if (token.type === 'check') fragment.append(renderCheck(token));
      else if (token.type === 'embed') fragment.append(renderEmbed(token));
      else fragment.append(renderNarration(token));
    }
    elements.content.replaceChildren(fragment);
  }

  // ===== 角色头像编辑：点名字 → 链接 / 上传 / 恢复默认；结果写入浏览器并与小手机共享 =====
  let avatarEditor = null;

  function ensureAvatarEditor() {
    if (avatarEditor) return avatarEditor;
    const panel = makeElement('div', 'lz-avatar-editor');
    panel.hidden = true;
    panel.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    panel.setAttribute('aria-label', '更换角色头像');
    const preview = makeElement('div', 'lz-avatar-editor__preview');
    const title = makeElement('strong', 'lz-avatar-editor__name');
    const close = makeElement('button', 'lz-icon-button lz-avatar-editor__close', '×');
    close.type = 'button';
    close.setAttribute('aria-label', '关闭');
    const head = makeElement('div', 'lz-avatar-editor__head');
    head.append(preview, title, close);
    const urlInput = makeElement('input', 'lz-avatar-editor__url');
    urlInput.type = 'url';
    urlInput.placeholder = '图片链接 https://…';
    urlInput.setAttribute('aria-label', '头像图片链接');
    const useUrl = makeElement('button', 'lz-avatar-editor__action', '用链接');
    useUrl.type = 'button';
    const upload = makeElement('button', 'lz-avatar-editor__action', '上传图片');
    upload.type = 'button';
    const reset = makeElement('button', 'lz-avatar-editor__action is-quiet', '恢复默认');
    reset.type = 'button';
    const row = makeElement('div', 'lz-avatar-editor__row');
    row.append(urlInput, useUrl);
    const actions = makeElement('div', 'lz-avatar-editor__actions');
    actions.append(upload, reset);
    panel.append(head, row, actions);
    root.append(panel);

    close.addEventListener('click', closeAvatarEditor);
    useUrl.addEventListener('click', () => applyAvatarUrl(urlInput.value));
    urlInput.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Enter') { event.preventDefault(); applyAvatarUrl(urlInput.value); }
    });
    upload.addEventListener('click', () => elements.avatarInput?.click());
    reset.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (!state.editingAvatar) return;
      try {
        writeAvatarOverride(state.editingAvatar, null);
        rerenderAfterAvatarChange();
        showToast(`已恢复 ${state.editingAvatar} 的默认头像`);
        closeAvatarEditor();
      } catch (error) {
        showToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '恢复失败');
      }
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !panel.hidden) closeAvatarEditor();
    });
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
      if (panel.hidden) return;
      const target = event.target;
      if (panel.contains(target) || (target instanceof Element && target.closest('.lz-dialogue__name'))) return;
      closeAvatarEditor();
    });
    avatarEditor = { panel, preview, title, urlInput, reset };
    return avatarEditor;
  }

  function refreshAvatarEditorPreview(character) {
    const editor = ensureAvatarEditor();
    const override = avatarOverrideSource(character.displayName);
    const source = override || (isPlayerSpeaker(character.displayName) ? state.playerAvatar : '') || (character.hasAvatar ? avatarUrl(character) : '');
    editor.preview.replaceChildren();
    editor.preview.style.setProperty('--lz-char-accent', character.accent || '#756B61');
    if (source) {
      const image = document.createElement('img');
      image.alt = '';
      image.src = source;
      editor.preview.append(image);
    } else {
      editor.preview.append(makeElement('span', '', character.fallbackGlyph || '？'));
    }
    editor.reset.disabled = !override;
  }

  function openAvatarEditor(character, anchor) {
    const editor = ensureAvatarEditor();
    state.editingAvatar = character.displayName;
    setText(editor.title, character.displayName);
    editor.urlInput.value = state.avatarOverrides[character.displayName]?.url || '';
    refreshAvatarEditorPreview(character);
    editor.panel.hidden = false;
    const rootRect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
    const anchorRect = anchor?.getBoundingClientRect?.() || rootRect;
    const top = anchorRect.bottom - rootRect.top + 8;
    const width = Math.min(360, rootRect.width - 24);
    const left = Math.max(12, Math.min(anchorRect.left - rootRect.left, rootRect.width - width - 12));
    editor.panel.style.top = `${top}px`;
    editor.panel.style.left = `${left}px`;
    editor.panel.style.width = `${width}px`;
    editor.urlInput.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  function closeAvatarEditor() {
    if (!avatarEditor) return;
    avatarEditor.panel.hidden = true;
    state.editingAvatar = '';
  }

  function rerenderAfterAvatarChange() {
    renderContent();
    observeAnimatedElements();
    updatePlayerAvatarStatus();
  }

  function applyAvatarUrl(value) {
    if (!state.editingAvatar) return;
    const url = normalizeAvatarUrl(value);
    if (!url) { showToast('请输入 http(s) 图片链接'); return; }
    try {
      writeAvatarOverride(state.editingAvatar, url.startsWith('data:') ? { dataUrl: url } : { url });
      rerenderAfterAvatarChange();
      showToast(`${state.editingAvatar} 的头像已更换`);
      closeAvatarEditor();
    } catch (error) {
      showToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '保存失败');
    }
  }

  function applySettings() {
    if (!THEME_KEYS.has(state.theme)) state.theme = systemTheme();
    if (!FONT_KEYS.has(state.font)) state.font = 'serif';
    state.fontSize = clamp(Number(state.fontSize) || 18, 14, 28);
    const effectiveMotion = state.motion && !reducedMotion?.matches;

    elements.body.dataset.lzTheme = state.theme;
    elements.body.classList.toggle('lz-theme-light', state.theme === 'white');
    elements.body.classList.toggle('lz-theme-dark', state.theme === 'black');
    elements.body.dataset.lzFont = state.font;
    elements.body.style.setProperty('--lz-font-size', `${state.fontSize}px`);
    elements.body.classList.toggle('lz-motion-off', !effectiveMotion);
    renderMetadata();
    if (elements.fontSelect) elements.fontSelect.value = state.font;
    setText(elements.fontSize, `${state.fontSize}px`);
    if (elements.motionToggle) elements.motionToggle.checked = state.motion;
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-lz-theme]').forEach((button) => {
      button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.lzTheme === state.theme));
    });
  }

  function openSettings() {
    state.lastFocused = document.activeElement;
    elements.settingsPanel.hidden = false;
    elements.settingsTrigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    elements.settingsTrigger.setAttribute('aria-label', '关闭阅读设置');
    elements.settingsClose?.focus();
  }

  function closeSettings() {
    elements.settingsPanel.hidden = true;
    elements.settingsTrigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    elements.settingsTrigger.setAttribute('aria-label', '打开阅读设置');
    if (state.lastFocused instanceof HTMLElement) state.lastFocused.focus();
  }

  function bindSettings() {
    elements.settingsTrigger?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (elements.settingsPanel.hidden) openSettings();
      else closeSettings();
    });
    elements.settingsClose?.addEventListener('click', closeSettings);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !elements.settingsPanel.hidden) closeSettings();
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-lz-theme]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.theme = button.dataset.lzTheme;
        writeSetting('theme', state.theme);
        applySettings();
      });
    });
    elements.fontSelect?.addEventListener('change', () => {
      state.font = FONT_KEYS.has(elements.fontSelect.value) ? elements.fontSelect.value : 'serif';
      writeSetting('font', state.font);
      applySettings();
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-lz-font-delta]').forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.fontSize = clamp(state.fontSize + Number(button.dataset.lzFontDelta), 14, 28);
        writeSetting('font-size', state.fontSize);
        applySettings();
      });
    });
    root.querySelector('[data-lz-font-reset]')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
      state.fontSize = 18;

    elements.motionToggle?.addEventListener('change', () => {
      state.motion = elements.motionToggle.checked;
      writeSetting('motion', state.motion);

    reducedMotion?.addEventListener?.('change', applySettings);
  }

  function showToast(message) {
    if (!elements.toast) return;
    setText(elements.toast, message);
    elements.toast.hidden = false;
    globalThis.clearTimeout(showToast.timer);
    showToast.timer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
      elements.toast.hidden = true;
    }, 2600);
  }

  function avatarStorageKey() {
    return `${STORAGE_PREFIX}player-avatar.${encodeURIComponent(playerName || 'default')}`;
  }

  function openAvatarDatabase() {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      if (!globalThis.indexedDB) {
        reject(new Error('IndexedDB unavailable'));
        return;
      }
      let settled = false;
      let timer = 0;
      let request;
      const finish = (kind, value) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        globalThis.clearTimeout(timer);
        if (kind === 'resolve') resolve(value);
        else reject(value);
      };
      try {
        request = globalThis.indexedDB.open(AVATAR_DATABASE, 1);
      } catch (error) {
        finish('reject', error);
        return;
      }
      timer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
        finish('reject', new Error('IndexedDB open timed out'));
      }, AVATAR_DATABASE_TIMEOUT);
      request.addEventListener('upgradeneeded', () => {
        if (!request.result.objectStoreNames.contains(AVATAR_STORE)) {
          request.result.createObjectStore(AVATAR_STORE, { keyPath: 'name' });
        }
      });
      request.addEventListener('success', () => {
        if (settled) {
          request.result.close();
          return;
        }
        finish('resolve', request.result);
      }, { once: true });
      request.addEventListener('error', () => finish('reject', request.error || new Error('IndexedDB open failed')), { once: true });
      request.addEventListener('blocked', () => finish('reject', new Error('IndexedDB open blocked')), { once: true });
    });
  }

  function runAvatarTransaction(database, mode, operation) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      let settled = false;
      let timer = 0;
      let requestResult = null;
      let transaction;
      const finish = (kind, value) => {
        if (settled) return;
        settled = true;
        globalThis.clearTimeout(timer);
        if (kind === 'resolve') resolve(value);
        else reject(value);
      };
      try {
        transaction = database.transaction(AVATAR_STORE, mode);
        const request = operation(transaction.objectStore(AVATAR_STORE));
        request?.addEventListener('success', () => {
          requestResult = request.result;
        }, { once: true });
        request?.addEventListener('error', () => {
          finish('reject', request.error || new Error('IndexedDB request failed'));
        }, { once: true });
      } catch (error) {
        finish('reject', error);
        return;
      }
      timer = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
        try {
          transaction.abort();
        } catch (_error) {
          // A transaction that already ended needs no further cleanup.
        }
        finish('reject', new Error('IndexedDB transaction timed out'));
      }, AVATAR_DATABASE_TIMEOUT);
      transaction.addEventListener('complete', () => finish('resolve', requestResult), { once: true });
      transaction.addEventListener('error', () => finish('reject', transaction.error || new Error('IndexedDB transaction failed')), { once: true });
      transaction.addEventListener('abort', () => finish('reject', transaction.error || new Error('IndexedDB transaction aborted')), { once: true });
    });
  }

  async function readAvatarDatabaseRecord() {
    let database = null;
    try {
      database = await openAvatarDatabase();
      return await runAvatarTransaction(database, 'readonly', (store) => store.get(playerName));
    } catch (_error) {
      return null;
    } finally {
      database?.close();
    }
  }

  function readAvatarLocalRecord() {
    try {
      return globalThis.localStorage?.getItem(avatarStorageKey()) || null;
    } catch (_error) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  async function readPlayerAvatar() {
    if (!playerName) return null;
    const [databaseValue, localValue] = await Promise.all([
      readAvatarDatabaseRecord(),
      Promise.resolve(readAvatarLocalRecord()),
    ]);
    const databaseRecord = core.normalizeAvatarRecord(databaseValue, playerName);
    const localRecord = core.normalizeAvatarRecord(localValue, playerName);
    lastAvatarStamp = Math.max(
      lastAvatarStamp,
      databaseRecord?.updatedAt || 0,
      localRecord?.updatedAt || 0,
    );
    return core.avatarDataFromRecord(
      core.chooseLatestAvatarRecord(databaseRecord, localRecord),
    );
  }

  async function writeAvatarDatabaseRecord(record) {
    let database = null;
    try {
      database = await openAvatarDatabase();
      await runAvatarTransaction(database, 'readwrite', (store) => store.put(record));
      return true;
    } catch (_error) {
      return false;
    } finally {
      database?.close();
    }
  }

  function writeAvatarLocalRecord(record) {
    try {
      globalThis.localStorage?.setItem(avatarStorageKey(), JSON.stringify(record));
      return true;
    } catch (_error) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  function nextAvatarStamp() {
    lastAvatarStamp = Math.max(Date.now(), lastAvatarStamp + 1);
    return lastAvatarStamp;
  }

  async function persistAvatarRecord(record) {
    const [databaseStored, localStored] = await Promise.all([
      writeAvatarDatabaseRecord(record),
      Promise.resolve(writeAvatarLocalRecord(record)),
    ]);
    return databaseStored || localStored;
  }

  function makeAvatarRecord(dataUrl, deleted) {
    return {
      name: playerName,
      dataUrl,
      updatedAt: nextAvatarStamp(),
      deleted,
    };
  }

  function writePlayerAvatar(dataUrl) {
    return persistAvatarRecord(makeAvatarRecord(dataUrl, false));
  }

  function deletePlayerAvatar() {
    return persistAvatarRecord(makeAvatarRecord(null, true));
  }

  function loadImage(source) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.addEventListener('load', () => resolve(image), { once: true });
      image.addEventListener('error', () => reject(new Error('无法读取图片')), { once: true });
      image.src = source;
    });
  }

  async function resizeAvatar(file) {
    if (!file || !AVATAR_TYPES.has(file.type)) {
      throw new Error('仅支持 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 图片');
    }
    if (file.size > AVATAR_FILE_LIMIT) throw new Error('图片不能超过 8MB');
    const header = new Uint8Array(
      await file.slice(0, Math.min(file.size, IMAGE_HEADER_LIMIT)).arrayBuffer(),
    );
    const metadata = core.validateAvatarImageHeader(header, file.type, IMAGE_PIXEL_LIMIT);
    if (!globalThis.URL?.createObjectURL || !globalThis.URL?.revokeObjectURL) {
      throw new Error('当前浏览器无法安全读取本地图片');
    }
    const objectUrl = globalThis.URL.createObjectURL(file);
    try {
      const image = await loadImage(objectUrl);
      if (image.naturalWidth !== metadata.width || image.naturalHeight !== metadata.height) {
        throw new Error('图片头信息与解码尺寸不一致');
      }
      const sourceSize = Math.min(image.naturalWidth, image.naturalHeight);
      const sourceX = (image.naturalWidth - sourceSize) / 2;
      const sourceY = (image.naturalHeight - sourceSize) / 2;
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = AVATAR_EDGE;
      canvas.height = AVATAR_EDGE;
      const context = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
      if (!context) throw new Error('当前浏览器无法处理图片');
      context.fillStyle = '#E9E3D8';
      context.fillRect(0, 0, AVATAR_EDGE, AVATAR_EDGE);
      context.drawImage(
        image,
        sourceX,
        sourceY,
        sourceSize,
        sourceSize,
        0,
        0,
        AVATAR_EDGE,
        AVATAR_EDGE,
      );
      return canvas.toDataURL('image/webp', 0.86);
    } finally {
      globalThis.URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
    }
  }

  function updatePlayerAvatarStatus() {
    const count = Object.keys(state.avatarOverrides).length;
    setText(elements.avatarStatus, count ? `已自定义 ${count} 位角色` : '点击正文中的名字即可更换');
    if (elements.avatarReset) elements.avatarReset.disabled = count === 0 && !state.playerAvatar;
  }

  function bindAvatarControls() {
    elements.avatarInput?.addEventListener('change', async () => {
      const [file] = elements.avatarInput.files || [];
      elements.avatarInput.value = '';
      if (!file) return;
      const target = state.editingAvatar || playerName;
      if (!target) return;
      const revision = avatarRevision.begin();
      try {
        await enqueueAvatarMutation(async () => {
          const dataUrl = await resizeAvatar(file);
          if (!avatarRevision.isCurrent(revision)) return;
          writeAvatarOverride(target, { dataUrl });
          if (isPlayerSpeaker(target)) {
            state.playerAvatar = dataUrl;
            await writePlayerAvatar(dataUrl).catch(() => false);
          }
          rerenderAfterAvatarChange();
          closeAvatarEditor();
          showToast(`${target} 的头像已保存在本机`);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        if (avatarRevision.isCurrent(revision)) {
          showToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '头像处理失败');
        }
      }
    });
    elements.avatarReset?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const revision = avatarRevision.begin();
      try {
        await enqueueAvatarMutation(async () => {
          for (const name of Object.keys(state.avatarOverrides)) writeAvatarOverride(name, null);
          if (playerName && state.playerAvatar) {
            await deletePlayerAvatar().catch(() => false);
            state.playerAvatar = null;
          }
          if (!avatarRevision.isCurrent(revision)) return;
          rerenderAfterAvatarChange();
          showToast('已恢复全部默认头像');
        });
      } catch (error) {
        if (avatarRevision.isCurrent(revision)) {
          showToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '头像重置失败');
        }
      }
    });
    // 小手机等同源页面改了头像时实时跟进。
    globalThis.addEventListener?.('storage', (event) => {
      if (event.key !== AVATAR_OVERRIDES_KEY) return;
      state.avatarOverrides = readAvatarOverrides();
      rerenderAfterAvatarChange();
    });
  }

  let visibilityObserver = null;
  function observeAnimatedElements() {
    visibilityObserver?.disconnect();
    const targets = root.querySelectorAll('.lz-dialogue, .lz-observed-effect');
    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in globalThis)) {
      targets.forEach((target) => target.classList.add('is-visible', 'is-in-view'));
      return;
    }
    visibilityObserver = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          entry.target.classList.toggle('is-in-view', entry.isIntersecting);
          if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.target.classList.contains('lz-observed-effect')) {
            entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
          }
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: '10% 0px 10%', threshold: 0.08 },
    );
    targets.forEach((target) => visibilityObserver.observe(target));
  }

  async function initialize() {
    renderMetadata();
    applySettings();
    bindSettings();
    renderContent();
    bindAvatarControls();
    updatePlayerAvatarStatus();
    observeAnimatedElements();
    const hydrationRevision = avatarRevision.current();
    const storedAvatar = await readPlayerAvatar();
    if (!avatarRevision.isCurrent(hydrationRevision) || !storedAvatar) return;
    state.playerAvatar = storedAvatar;
    renderContent();
    updatePlayerAvatarStatus();
    observeAnimatedElements();
  }

  initialize().catch(() => {
    renderContent();
    applySettings();
  });
})();
